name: Zuri
description: Zuri is a caramel-furred meerkat girl pop star, Pixar-style 3D render. EXACT canon, never change: TWO pink roses on top of her head; a YELLOW long-sleeve crop sweater with a BLUE HEART containing a GOLD STAR on the chest; black shorts with a small gold chain; red sandals with little roses; pink beaded bracelets and anklets; a small star earring; big round expressive brown eyes; fluffy caramel fur with darker spots; warm friendly smile. Energetic, sweet and confident kids singer (ages 8-14). Do NOT alter her outfit, colors, roses or proportions; do NOT put roses or flowers on any other character.
